faq_heading: Homes near Forsyth Road Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Forsyth Road Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Forsyth Road Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Forsyth Road Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Forsyth Road Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Our Lady of Good Counsel (0.5 km south), Honour Secondary School (0.7 km south-west) and Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (1.0 km east).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Forsyth Road Elementary

23 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Forsyth Road Elementary in a straight line (17 elementary, 6 secondary; 3 independent). The closest is Our Lady of Good Counsel, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is SD 36 Alternate North Surrey LC, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Honour Secondary School (0.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Kwantlen Park Secondary (1.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: Our Lady of Good Counsel (0.5 km south), Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (1.0 km east), James Ardiel Elementary (1.0 km north), Surrey Traditional (1.1 km north), Ellendale Elementary (1.4 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Our Lady of Good Counsel, 0.5 km south of Forsyth Road Elementary.
